data.title: Feature gap — kadence against the tools a 3–8 agent team actually weighs
body: # Feature gap — kadence against the tools a 3–8 agent team actually weighs
- **Date:** 2026-09-16 · **Replaces:** the 2026-09-03 analysis (Ukrainian), which compared kadence 0.1 with Jira, ClickUp, Linear, Notion and Planner

- **Decision this supports:** which gaps to close before and during the pilots (strategy P2, to 2026-11-13) and which to keep refusing out loud. It does not reorder [plan-to-1.0](../../tasks/plan-to-1.0.md); feature work is frozen behind the outreach gates in [strategy §4](DOC-35).

- **Comparison set:** what the ICP already has or is choosing between — **Beads**, **Backlog.md**, **Spec Kit**, **Claude Code Tasks + Auto Memory**, **git-bug**, **ai-memory**, and **Linear or Jira reached from the prompt through MCP**. General-purpose trackers are no longer the reference: the ICP either lives in them already (then "Not for", strategy §1) or has moved work into the repository.

- **Method:** competitors' READMEs, release notes and issue trackers read through the GitHub API and web pages on 2026-09-16; vendor docs for Claude Code, Linear and Atlassian. kadence from the product inventory of 2026-09-16 (binary `--help`, `schema --json`, `CHANGELOG.md`). A capability counts only if the competitor's own primary source documents it; whether it works well is not judged here.
- **Labels:** **Fact** · **Inference** · **Assumption**, as elsewhere.
## What happened to the old gaps
Every "basic" gap the 2026-09-03 document found is closed. Nothing on this list is a gap any more.
| Task cannot be edited | `task edit` (0.1.0), labels as deltas (0.4) |
| No cancel, no comments | `task cancel`, `task comment` with `source` human/agent |
| No due date, search, bulk ops | `--due`, `--overdue`, `--search` over titles, descriptions and comments, `task move KAD-1,KAD-2` |
| No subtasks, dependencies | `task parent`, `--tree`, `task block` with cycles reported, not rejected |
| No burndown, templates | `sprint burndown`, `template save` |
| No interactive board | `kadence ui` — TUI kanban with mouse and drag, lazily loaded (blessed, 22 ms import) |
**Inference.** The question has changed from "is kadence a complete tracker?" to "what does an agent-using team get elsewhere that kadence refuses or has not built?"
## Competitors on 2026-09-16
| Tool | Version, date | Stars | Downloads / 30 d | Storage and source of truth | Source (accessed 2026-09-16) |

| **kadence** | 0.4.1, 2026-09-13 | — | 355 (npm, 08-13…09-11) | append-only JSON events in `.kadence/events/`, committed | inventory; [npm API](https://api.npmjs.org/downloads/point/last-month/kadence) |

| **Beads** (`bd`) | v1.3.0, 2026-09-15 | 27,188 | 22,789 (`@beads/bd`) | **Dolt only** (embedded or server); sync through `refs/dolt/data`; `issues.jsonl` "an export … not the source of truth" | [README](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads), [v1.3.0 notes](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/releases/tag/v1.3.0) |

| **Backlog.md** | v1.52.0, 2026-09-12 | 6,743 | 57,360 (`backlog.md`) | one Markdown file per task, mutable, in the repo | [README](https://github.com/MrLesk/Backlog.md), [releases](https://github.com/MrLesk/Backlog.md/releases) |

| **Spec Kit** | v1.0.7, 2026-09-15 | 137,163 | — (Python, `uv`) | spec, plan and task Markdown in the repo | [README](https://github.com/github/spec-kit), [v1.0.7](https://github.com/github/spec-kit/releases/tag/v1.0.7) |

| **Claude Code** Tasks + Auto Memory | shipped Jan–Feb 2026 | — | — | `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/`, `~/.claude/tasks/` — machine-local | [memory docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory), [.claude directory](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-directory), [agent teams](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams) |
| **git-bug** | v0.10.1, 2025-05-19 (commits to 2026-09-16) | 10,029 | — (Go) | git objects in custom refs, "not files" | [README](https://github.com/git-bug/git-bug) |

| **ai-memory** | v2.2.2, 2026-09-15 | 6,965 | — (Rust binary, Docker) | git-backed Markdown wiki **in a server's data directory**, SQLite index derived | [README](https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory) |

| **Linear / Jira via MCP** | Linear hosted MCP; Atlassian Rovo MCP GA 2026-02-04 | — | — | the SaaS | [Linear MCP docs](https://linear.app/docs/mcp), [Atlassian GA](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/announcements/atlassian-rovo-mcp-ga) |

**Fact.** The 2026-09-02 snapshot's third competitor, `steviee/git-issues`, has **17 stars** and no push since 2026-05-06 (GitHub API). It leaves the set. The npm package named `git-issues` (2,055 downloads) could not be tied to that repository — **Assumption** that they are unrelated.
## Feature matrix
Legend: ✅ documented · ◐ partial or different shape · ❌ not offered · — not applicable. Short notes inside a cell say what makes a mark non-obvious.
### A. Where the truth lives
| Capability | kadence | Beads | Backlog.md | Spec Kit | CC Tasks/Memory | git-bug | ai-memory | Linear/Jira MCP |
| Work state as plain files in the working tree, same commit as the code | ✅ | ❌ Dolt | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ `~/.claude` | ❌ git objects | ❌ server data dir | ❌ |

| Append-only history as the source of truth | ✅ | ◐ events journal opt-in, **clone-local, never pushed** | ❌ files edited | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ operations in git | ◐ audit log on server | ◐ activity log in SaaS |
| `git checkout` of an old commit shows that day's board | ✅ | ❌ | ◐ files at that commit, no history | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

| No server, daemon or database to run | ✅ | ◐ embedded Dolt, single writer; `bd serve` optional | ◐ CLI yes; web UI and MCP are local servers | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (web UI optional) | ❌ server required | ❌ SaaS |
| Works fully offline, no account | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (agent needs its API) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ self-hosted | ❌ |
| Merge without conflict when branches edit one task | ✅ by construction | ◐ Dolt cell merge; `bd sync` halts on conflict | ❌ mutable files | ❌ | — | ✅ | — | — |

| IDs that cannot collide across clones | ✅ ULID, `KAD-N` derived | ✅ hash IDs | ❌ sequential; collision-free mode **closed not planned** ([#711](https://github.com/MrLesk/Backlog.md/issues/711)); ID reuse bug open ([#997](https://github.com/MrLesk/Backlog.md/issues/997)) | — | — | ✅ | — | ✅ server-assigned |
### B. The agent loop
| Capability | kadence | Beads | Backlog.md | Spec Kit | CC Tasks/Memory | git-bug | ai-memory | Linear/Jira MCP |
| "What can I start" (`ready`) | ✅ | ✅ `bd ready` | ✅ `--ready`, `isReady` (v1.51) | ◐ task list order | ◐ unblocked tasks self-claimed in agent teams (experimental) | ❌ | ❌ | ◐ query |
| Session preamble for the agent | ✅ `prime` ≤ 40 lines | ✅ `bd prime` with memories | ✅ overview once per conversation | ✅ constitution | ✅ `MEMORY.md` 200 lines / 25 KB | ❌ | ✅ bounded brief | ❌ |
| Session hook installed by the tool | ✅ `init --hooks` (asked) | ✅ `bd setup claude/codex/cursor…` | ◐ MCP auto-config | ✅ per-agent skills | — native | ❌ | ✅ lifecycle hooks | ❌ |

| Claim | ◐ event; contested visible after merge, no lock | ✅ atomic claim, **leases with heartbeat and `reclaim`**, compare-and-set (v1.3.0) | ❌ requested ([#937](https://github.com/MrLesk/Backlog.md/issues/937), open) | ❌ | ✅ in agent teams, same machine | ❌ | ✅ handoffs "claimed exactly once" | ✅ assignee |

| Stable JSON contract with error codes | ✅ `kadence/v1`, 15 codes, `schema --json` | ✅ exit codes, typed `code` on HTTP | ◐ `--json`, no published schema found | ◐ `specify artifact` JSON | ❌ | ◐ | ✅ HTTP/MCP API | ✅ MCP tools |
| Output narrowing for token cost | ✅ `--fields`, `--summary` | ✅ `--brief` (−93.4% measured) | ◐ `--plain` | — | ✅ index + topic files | — | ✅ bounded brief | ◐ |
| CLI first, MCP optional | ✅ no MCP (Probe C: ~700 tokens/session saved) | ✅ CLI + `beads-mcp` | ✅ CLI default since docs change; MCP optional | ✅ | — | ✅ | ◐ MCP primary | ❌ MCP only |
| Human vs agent authorship on records | ✅ `source` on every event | ◐ caller-asserted `actor` | ❌ found none | ❌ | ❌ | ◐ author identity | ✅ per-person attribution + audit | ◐ token owner |
| Automatic capture of what the agent did | ❌ explicit writes only | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Claude writes memories itself | ❌ | ✅ hooks capture prompts and tool calls | ❌ |
| Multi-vendor (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) reading one store | ✅ via `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ Claude only | ◐ | ✅ 20+ harnesses | ✅ |
| Live stream of changes | ❌ | ✅ `bd events tail --follow` | ✅ `task list --json --watch` (v1.52) | ❌ | ✅ broadcast between sessions | ❌ | ◐ | ◐ webhooks |
### C. Decisions and memory
| Capability | kadence | Beads | Backlog.md | Spec Kit | CC Tasks/Memory | git-bug | ai-memory | Linear/Jira MCP |

| Decision record with why and rejected alternatives | ✅ `--why` required, `--rejected`, `--supersedes` as one event | ◐ `supersedes` graph link; `remember` | ◐ `decisions/` Markdown, `decision list` | ◐ plan/research docs | ◐ `project` memory type | ❌ | ◐ wiki pages | ◐ comments |
| Free-form notes / memories | ✅ `note` | ✅ `bd remember` | ◐ task notes | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ◐ |
| Semantic or vector recall | ❌ non-goal | ◐ "memory decay" compaction | ◐ fuzzy search | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ full-text + optional vectors | ✅ semantic search (Rovo) |
| Spec → plan → tasks → converge | ❌ non-goal | ❌ | ◐ AC + plan in task | ✅ `/speckit-converge` | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Linked documents | ✅ `task doc add` creates and links | ❌ | ✅ `docs/` | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ Confluence |
### D. Human surfaces and planning
| Capability | kadence | Beads | Backlog.md | Spec Kit | CC Tasks/Memory | git-bug | ai-memory | Linear/Jira MCP |
| Terminal board | ✅ TUI | ◐ community tools | ✅ TUI, milestone swimlanes | ❌ | ◐ Ctrl+T task list | ✅ TUI | ❌ | ❌ |
| Web UI | ◐ static HTML export only (non-goal: server) | ◐ community; `bd serve` API | ✅ local, drag-and-drop | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ with code browser | ✅ read-only | ✅ SaaS |
| Acceptance criteria + Definition of Done | ✅ | ◐ `acceptance_criteria` field | ✅ with progress | ✅ checklists | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ◐ |
| Milestones, due dates | ✅ | ◐ epics, defer `--until` | ✅ (due dates v1.51) | ❌ | ❌ | ◐ labels | ❌ | ✅ |
| Dependencies with cycle handling | ✅ cycles **reported** | ✅ graph, cycles command | ✅ cycles **rejected**, transitive graph shown (v1.51) | ❌ | ✅ blocks | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Sprints, velocity, burndown | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Flow metrics (cycle time percentiles, CFD, aging) | ✅ `report flow`, `report cfd` | ◐ `stats` | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ◐ Linear insights / Jira reports |
| "Nobody is looking at this" report | ✅ `report attention` | ◐ `bd reclaim --older-than` for expired leases | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ found none |

| Bridge to GitHub/Jira | ◐ one-way publish to GitHub (`@kadence/github`) | ❌ | ◐ board export to README | ◐ `taskstoissues`, moving to a `github` extension | ❌ | ✅ **two-way** GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Launchpad | ❌ | — |
| Import from another tracker | ❌ (planned 0.6, gated) | ✅ JSONL import, legacy SQLite extract | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ bridges | ✅ migration from other memory tools | ✅ importers |
### E. Operations and trust
| Capability | kadence | Beads | Backlog.md | Spec Kit | CC Tasks/Memory | git-bug | ai-memory | Linear/Jira MCP |
| Runtime dependencies | 1 (blessed, TUI only) | Dolt embedded | Bun-compiled binary | Python 3.11 + uv | — | Go binary | Rust binary | — |
| Single binary / Homebrew | ❌ / ❌ | ✅ / ✅ | ✅ / ✅, Nix | ❌ | — | ✅ | ✅ AUR, Docker | — |
| Windows | ◐ untested in CI | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ◐ experimental | ✅ |
| `doctor` / repair command | ❌ (G5, later) | ✅ `bd doctor` | ✅ collision diagnosis and recovery (PR #749) | ❌ | ✅ `/doctor` | ❌ | ✅ reindex/restore | — |
| Upgrades migrate stored data | ✅ none needed — state is folded | ❌ ~28 migrations v53→v66 on first run | ◐ | ◐ | — | ◐ | ◐ reindex | — |
| Paid tier or hosting | ❌ never gated | ◐ "open-core split" mentioned in v1.3.0 notes | ❌ | ❌ | subscription | ❌ | ❌ ("not a paid tier") | ✅ SaaS |
## kadence's gaps, sorted

**Matters for the ICP** means it touches a job or pain in [the canvas](DOC-62) for a 3–8 team with agents. **Non-goal** means it breaks "no server, no account, no network" or a written decision; it stays refused and the refusal is stated. **Watch** means real but not worth building before Probe B.
### Matters for the ICP
| # | Gap | Who has it | Why it matters | Smallest shape that survives our constraints | Label |

| G-1 | **No automatic capture** — the journal only knows what someone writes | ai-memory (hooks), Claude Auto Memory | The one tech lead we heard said drift comes from attention; explicit writes depend on attention too. If the second author's agent does not write, the North Star cannot move | Not capture of prompts. Candidate: a `Stop`/`SessionEnd` hook suggestion that asks the agent to write a `note` if it changed a task — installed only with `init --hooks`, like `prime`. **Ask pilots first** | **Inference** / **Assumption** |

| G-2 | **Claims have no expiry or recovery verb** | Beads (leases, `heartbeat`, `reclaim`, CAS) | A dead agent's claim hides work from `ready` for everyone | `report attention` already flags `stale_claim`; a `task release --stale` or `ready --include-stale` is a fold, needs no lock | **Fact** (gap) / **Inference** (priority) |

| G-3 | **No importer** from Beads or Backlog.md | Beads, git-bug, ai-memory import | Door 2 (switchers) cannot open without it | T67/T68, behind the Oct 19 and `/from-beads` fake-door gates | **Fact** |

| G-4 | **Node ≥ 20 required; no binary, no Homebrew, no Windows CI** | Beads, Backlog.md, git-bug, ai-memory | "No Node ≥ 20" is in the ICP's *Not for*; a second author on Windows is a silent drop-off | CI matrix first (hours); binary only if a pilot is blocked | **Fact** |

| G-5 | **No `doctor`** | Beads, Backlog.md, Claude Code | A lead's trust at the first odd state; "Deleting `state.json` changes nothing" is true but undiscoverable | `kadence doctor`: rebuild cache, verify every event parses, report orphans and contested claims (G5) | **Inference** |

| G-6 | **`schema --json` omits shipped commands** (`sprint add/edit/start/list/burndown`, `template *`, `completion`, `ui`, `task parent/unblock/cancel/delete`) | — | Agents trust the contract; missing entries are invisible capabilities | additive entries within `kadence/v1` — no rename, no removal | **Fact** (inventory §4) |
### Watch — real, not before Probe B
| # | Gap | Who has it | Why wait |
| W-1 | Which model did the work | nobody records models; ai-memory records persons | contract and surveillance risk; one request (n = 1) |
| W-2 | Live stream (`--watch`, `events tail`) | Backlog.md, Beads | needs a process that outlives the command; the use case (dashboards, orchestrators) is not the ICP's |
| W-3 | Transitive dependency view in `task show` | Backlog.md v1.51 | cheap fold; nobody asked |
| W-4 | Burnup, time in status, epic rollup | Linear/Jira | next report gaps per [reports discovery](DOC-60); velocity is not a pull |
| W-5 | Rich web UI | Backlog.md, git-bug, ai-memory | static export is the experiment; kill condition "nobody opens it twice" untested |
### Deliberate non-goals — keep refusing
| Refused | Who has it | Reason on record |
| Hosted server, HTTP API, accounts | Beads `bd serve`, ai-memory, Linear/Jira | core makes no network request; CLAUDE.md "Never" |
| Two-way sync with GitHub/Jira | git-bug bridges | turns kadence into a bridge; one-way publish only (ADR-012) |
| MCP server | Backlog.md, Beads, ai-memory | Probe C: ~700 tokens more per session; only when a named user cannot run the CLI |
| Semantic/vector memory, recall over transcripts | ai-memory, Rovo | not a "memory for agents" product (discovery verdict) |
| Spec-driven workflow, converge | Spec Kit | "not competing with Spec Kit on specifications" (roadmap-to-1.0 §7) |
| Capturing prompts and tool calls | ai-memory | privacy, and an append-only journal cannot erase what it should not have kept |
| Locks across machines | Beads (row lock in Dolt) | no process outlives the command; contested is surfaced, not prevented (ADR-011) |
| Rejecting dependency cycles | Backlog.md | rejection makes state depend on merge order (I1) |
| Manual timers, hours in workload, averages | Jira, Linear | derived from events; no means anywhere |
## What this means

1. **Table stakes are met.** Against the agent-first trackers kadence is at parity on `ready`, preamble, claims, criteria, milestones, JSON contract and token narrowing. Nobody chooses it for those. **Fact.**

2. **The distinctive column is narrower and sharper than on 2026-09-03.** Only kadence keeps an **append-only, versioned, pushed** history as plain files in the commit. Beads now has an events journal, but it is clone-local and "never versioned, never pushed or federated" (v1.3.0 notes). Backlog.md keeps sequential IDs by choice. **Fact.**

3. **The biggest gap is not a feature on anyone's roadmap list; it is capture.** Every competitor that aims at "shared context" either captures automatically (ai-memory, Auto Memory) or runs a server that coordinates writers (Beads, ai-memory). kadence does neither and depends on agents writing when told. That is Assumption N2 in the strategy, seen from the product side. **Inference.**

4. **Beads moved toward infrastructure** (HTTP API, bearer tokens, leases, 28 migrations). That widens the "nothing to run" contrast and narrows the "atomic multi-agent coordination" one. **Fact** (release) / **Inference** (direction).

5. **Close G-6 and G-2 first if any feature slot opens** — both are folds or contract entries, S-sized, and both make existing features trustworthy rather than adding surface. G-1 is a question for pilots before it is a task. **Inference.**
